title: Digitalized CAD/CAM protocol for the fabrication of customized sealing socket healing abutments in immediate implants in molar sites.*
authors: Finelle G, Sanz-Martín I, Knafo B, Figué M, Popelut A. Int J Comput Dent. 2019; 22(2):187-204.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The authors summarized that the use of a CAD/CAM -fabricated healing abutment in immediate implant placement is a viable treatment option for the management of molar extraction sites. *Publication in English and German” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
